title: One SDK call, end to end (client.flights.search)
caption: Every method follows this path: namespace → core.call (client.js) → session.send (session.js) → http.send (http.js) → fetch. A 503 is retried with the same Idempotency-Key; a 4xx is mapped to its error class and thrown at once.

steps.label: core.call(op.flights_search, params, live(options))
steps.note: `live()` adds `cache: "no-store"` unless the call set `cache` or `next`.

steps.label: validateRequestOptions → TypeError on an unknown option (before any request)
fillPath / encodeQuery / headerParams (ifMatch → If-Match) / rest → JSON body
session.send({ method: POST, path: /v1/flight-searches, idempotency: required, retry: idempotent, timeoutMs: 60000 })
withFixedIdempotencyKey: one UUID v4 for the whole call
send(config, request) with credentials(): X-Api-Key, Authorization, X-Booking-Token
fetch POST /v1/flight-searches (Accept, Content-Type, Idempotency-Key, Accept-Language, X-Currency, X-Velexis-End-User-*)
retry 1 of maxRetries (2): wait Retry-After (2 s); > 30 s would throw at once
onResponse({ method, path, status, requestId, durationMs }) per attempt
result (a Page<T> when the operation has a cursor query param)
steps.note: On a non-2xx answer errors.js builds the class from status and code (400/422 ValidationError … 409 PRICE_CHANGED → PriceChangedError) and the call rejects with it.
